title: pleurogramme minor
intro: Pleurogramme minor, commonly known as the Red Button Fern, is a species of fern native to tropical regions of Asia and the Pacific. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, as well as being used as a diuretic and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Pleurogramme minor include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and lower blood pressure, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenes. The bioactive constituents of the Red Button Fern have been studied for their potential to inhibit the growth of cancer cells and reduce the severity of allergic reactions.
